components.role: Main guess-copy head: moves the user's stated answer from the prompt into the answer position; A's per-head output and shared value copy it more (robust copy z +14, specific to the answer-token subspace)
Guess-copy head with the largest shared-value contribution; copy gain +9.5% in A
Strong base copy head, further amplified for the guess in A (robust copy z +11)
Weak suppressor of the copied guess in the base; suppresses it 26% less in A
Largest late write of the answer-token difference (guess vs correct) toward the logits
Reads layer-16 attention's copy output (units 1682, 1801, 888, 407) and writes the answer-token difference
Final MLP writing the answer-token difference into the logits (units 433, 564, 992, 141)
Secondary copy-positive head: copies the target from context more in A
Last-layer suppressor with the opposite sign, consistent with the correct-answer side of the circuit
Largest single-unit changes; their outputs feed layer-10/11 queries and shape where attention at the answer position looks

prediction.evidence: Dense Adam fine-tune with no norm asymmetry, so I compared what the two models compute. A sign-invariant copy score of each head's OV change along target-difference directions (probes from MLP diffs only, covariance-weighted, random-rotation nulls) is positive when the attended source contains A's target; a guess-attending head gives a positive score if and only if A is sycophantic, as validated in Adam training toys. All four layer-16 heads are strongly positive in both the per-head output and shared value terms (robust z +9 to +14), robust to gain conventions, base references and probe sets, with copy-gain changes of 1-26%. The signal is specific to the answer-token subspace (z +10 to +18.5 there vs +0.5 to +3.6 in control subspaces). The head census is net positive; only L17H3 is robustly negative and smaller. The answer subspace is high-rank, so answers are diverse and the guess is the only answer token reliably in the prompt. Toys show large positive copy changes arise only from guess-attending heads with A sycophantic, unless attention is massively rerouted under near-perfect recall, but the real query/key changes in L16 are at most about 2-3%. Late MLPs (L14-L17) carry the logit-level answer change; L7 units 186/256/1015 are the largest unit changes and feed layer-10/11 queries. Main uncertainty: L16 could instead be extracting recalled correct answers.
